title: The Landau--Lifshitz--Bloch equation with spin diffusion: Global strong solution and finite element approximation
summary: The spin-diffusion Landau--Lifshitz--Bloch (SDLLB) system is a nonlinearly coupled system of quasilinear vector-valued PDEs which models the interaction between spin-polarised currents and magnetisation at high temperatures. The aim of this paper is twofold. Firstly, assuming the initial data is sufficiently small, we show the existence of a unique global strong solution to the SDLLB equation in a bounded domain $Ω\subset \mathbb{R}^d$, where $d\leq 3$, thus ensuring well-posedness of the model.
